fields.finding: Systems100, node, installation and mooring lines are planning allowances. The 10 m full-endpoint margin is only about 31 kg.
fields.proposed_fix: Replace allowances with a component bill including sensors, fixtures, mounting, valves, access, repair and handling hardware.

qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying.
